report.summary: 4 reviewed findings: 2 confirmed (silent-anchor-failure medium, exception-leak high), 1 narrowed (lane-assignment-gap critical), 1 blocked (docstring-vs-code-gap high). Plan: fix confirmed items first, then investigate narrowed and blocked items.
risks: Fixing silent-anchor-failure may require changes to read_anchor and verify_chain in daedalus/spine/docrefs.py; existing tests may need updates.
Exception-leak fix in gated_writes.py must not break existing error handling or introduce new bugs.
Lane-assignment-gap investigation may reveal no actual gap; effort could be wasted.
Docstring-vs-code-gap requires reading full files; if implementation is correct, no changes needed.
todos: 1. Fix silent-anchor-failure: make read_anchor raise or log on corrupt anchor.
2. Fix exception-leak: wrap promote_candidates with broader exception handling.
4. Investigate docstring-vs-code-gap: read full ceiling.py and inventory.py.

items.title: Fix silent-anchor-failure: make read_anchor raise or log on corrupt anchor
items.why_now: Confirmed finding: corrupt anchor file silently disables truncation detection. Fixing prevents data integrity issues.

steps.do: Modify read_anchor in daedalus/spine/docrefs.py to log a warning or raise an exception when JSONDecodeError occurs, instead of returning None.
steps.verified_by: Create a corrupt anchor file, run verify_chain, and observe that an error is logged or raised (test via pytest).

steps.do: Update verify_chain to treat None from read_anchor as an error (e.g., raise or log).
steps.verified_by: Test that verify_chain fails or logs when anchor is missing/corrupt.

items.assumption: read_anchor and verify_chain are in daedalus/spine/docrefs.py as cited.

items.title: Fix exception-leak: wrap promote_candidates with broader exception handling
items.why_now: Confirmed finding: promote_candidates may raise unhandled exceptions (e.g., OSError) contradicting its docstring. Fix prevents crashes.

steps.do: In daedalus/kairos/gated_writes.py, wrap the body of promote_candidates with a try-except that catches Exception and logs or re-raises a controlled error.
steps.verified_by: Run grep -n 'except\|raise' daedalus/kairos/gated_writes.py | head -20 to confirm new except clause exists; run existing tests to ensure no regression.

items.assumption: promote_candidates is in daedalus/kairos/gated_writes.py as cited.

items.title: Investigate lane-assignment-gap: inspect default_participants and _run_rewrite
items.why_now: Narrowed finding: if default_participants does not set lane and profiles are optional, adapters may run with unintended lane. Needs investigation to determine if fix is needed.

steps.do: Read the full default_participants function in daedalus/council/session.py to see if lane is set.
steps.verified_by: Output the function body; if lane is not set, proceed to next step.

steps.do: Read the full _run_rewrite function in daedalus/providers/ollama.py to see if it checks lane before writing files.
steps.verified_by: Output the function body; if lane check is missing, log finding.

items.assumption: default_participants is in daedalus/council/session.py and _run_rewrite is in daedalus/providers/ollama.py as cited.
